text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How was it, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Was my back...
able to guide everyone?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Almost a full year has passed
since taking on the challenge in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If this could at least serve as some inspiration
for them, nothing would make me happier.
choice_data_list: It's too early to be feeling retired.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you talk a big game.
Can't you see the burning fighting spirit in me, though?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I am looking ahead as well.
The next target is, of course—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh... That was spot-on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"This will be my second time, but it's completely different from last year...
I shall show everyone a race worthy of being my crowning achievement."

Seeing Symboli Rudolf brim with dignified determination,
there was one more thing I had to tell her.
And that was...
choice_data_list: Apparently Maruzensky is also scheduled to race

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Maruzensky did.
Huh...
On the way back...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Hm, that is...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
...That about covers the tour outside the academy.
Do you have any questions?

It's one of the student council general affairs staff.
She's accompanied by several Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, today was the off-campus
orientation for the new student council members, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Um, as I thought...
I might not be cut out for the student council... after all.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
...!
Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I used to look up to the President.
But after seeing today's race..."

text_block_list.name: Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"She's on a completely different dimension...
It feels pointless to even admire her..."

Symboli Rudolf didn't move.
She seemed to be waiting to see how the student council clerk would guide the situation.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
――I understand.
Because there were times when I wanted to give up, too.

text_block_list.name: Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was no way I could handle it,
got disgusted with myself, and gave up on who I was...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
Even now, there's still so much I can't do, but
I can say with absolute confidence that
I've grown compared to who I used to be!

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
"So, if you want to change who you are now...
Won't you try hanging in there just a little bit longer?"

text_block_list.name: Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I-I understand...
I'll try... a little harder!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Same goes for the race, but...
it's truly a joy to watch your juniors grow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even after I depart, the academy's future remains secure.
I believe that from the bottom of my heart.

Symboli Rudolf seems refreshed, as if freed from
a burden. Right now... I can make my proposal!
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask, though...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That's rather sudden.
Still, let's hear it.
choice_data_list: Forget about your titles at the "Arima Kinen".
Forget about your title at the "Arima Kinen".

text_block_list.text:
"In this race, forget about 'President' or 'Emperor'
—I want you to run purely as a single Umamusume, 'Symboli Rudolf.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet that defies my pride as the "Emperor."
If I do not run bearing the weight of everything, then I am not myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Why not?
It's fine to forget everything once in a while."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove!
You were here too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just as an escort.
Now then... President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Regarding what we discussed earlier, I share the same opinion as that Trainer over there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, the President has strictly disciplined herself
in every race in order to embody her ideals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"However, the next generation is coming along nicely as well.
Why not run as you please, just this once?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have always run as I pleased.
Calling myself the "Emperor" is my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you really are stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Then, how about these terms?
Saying it is for our sake.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yours...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm also curious to see what kind of race the President would run if she followed her heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――As an Umamusume who seeks competition.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That must be everyone's wish as well.
I would truly love the opportunity to learn from it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the "President,"
won't you show us how you compete just as you are?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly.
You've gotten quite skilled at hyping me up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you win.
When both my right-hand man and my Trainer beg me like this, I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, I'll run without worrying
about acting like the 'Emperor' or being 'Student Council President.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just how effective it'll be remains an unknown, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too.
—I'm really looking forward to it.
